purpose: One regression witness per registered ambiguity. A vector fixes an input pattern, the terminal state it must reach, and the numeric output it must produce. A specification edit that reopens an ambiguity fails its vector.
acc_notation: acc is written as a run-length list of [value, count] pairs over jj = 0..600, so acc[0] is always true per state_machine.yaml zero_node

vectors.closes: ZERO-01 — F1/B6 — case B returned a value the same section forbade
vectors.must_not: raise any label asserting mu = 0 is inadmissible; L95 = 0.0 is a permitted result

vectors.closes: TIE-01 — F2/B2 — no tie rule for the reported argmax
vectors.scenario: muhat = mumax, so Qstat is identically zero on the whole grid

vectors.closes: IDX-01 — F3/B3 — counters indexed by jj fire where no jj exists
vectors.scenario: a G4 drop and an edge fit occur at a refined node and at a bisection node
vectors.counter_contract: edge and degenerate events are accumulated over the (keyModel, keyRlo, keyStage) bucket; the jj axis is not used off the coarse grid

vectors.closes: EMPTY-01 — F4/B7 — max and min over an empty set
vectors.scenario: every one of the ten grid nodes reaches RANGE_INSUFFICIENT, so no node is retained
vectors.must_not: return -inf, +inf or nan from an empty max or min

vectors.closes: INP-01 — F5/B4 — gcurve column, units and extrapolation unstated
vectors.scenario: control 3 is evaluated on a gcurve whose abscissa is in h^-1 Mpc and extends beyond the fitted range on one side and stops short on the other
vectors.expected_behaviour: abscissa multiplied by 1/hdata, ordinate column 1 taken as g, numpy.interp with end-value clamping
vectors.expected_control_3: a single finite number, report-only, no verb

vectors.closes: MASK-01 — F6 — MODEL-R declared over an r_lo axis it does not run on
vectors.scenario: MODEL-R is evaluated only at r_lo = 6.0
vectors.must_not: report structural zeros as if they were measured 0/1 states

vectors.closes: PAIR-01 — B13 — monotonicity pairing specified two incompatible ways
vectors.scenario: node kk = 5 is excluded; kk = 4 and kk = 6 are retained
vectors.expected_pairing: excluded nodes remove both comparisons that involve them; kk = 4 is NOT compared with kk = 6

vectors.closes: QUAD-01 — B5 — quadrature had no named routine or subdivision limit
vectors.scenario: an integrand that exhausts the subdivision limit

vectors.closes: CTRL-03 — B11 — control 5's operands were fixed by a rule pointing at the wrong quantity
vectors.scenario: control 5 compares each kernel against its own 1e-12 recomputation

vectors.closes: RNG-01 — B1 — the coverage threshold's stream was ambiguous
vectors.scenario: the coverage study needs Q95 at muTrue
vectors.expected_source: recomputed under rootVal at keyStage = 0, nsim = 100000, not reused from the section 10 scan

vectors.closes: TERM-01 — F9/B9 — two terminal verbs never said which items are absent
vectors.scenario: INVALID_INPUT fires at guard G3, after the kernels exist

vectors.closes: CTRL-02 — F8 — item 8 required all nine controls while some had not run
vectors.expected_behaviour: all nine controls run to completion and emit their measured values; only then is STOP_RUN honoured

vectors.closes: CTRL-01 — F12 — controls 5 and 6 did not say how many values they emit
vectors.verdict_rule: the verdict is taken on the maximum over the emitted values

vectors.closes: LIST-01 — F7 — the excluded-node list had two populations
vectors.scenario: one node excluded by a label, one node numeric but with SdMC NOT_DEFINED

vectors.closes: ANNO-01 — F10 — annotations were attached to items while the label set forbade emitting them
vectors.expected_behaviour: annotations live in a separate report field, not in the outcome-label set

vectors.closes: SHAPE-01 — F11 — float shapes declared for arrays that must hold labels
vectors.expected_representation: value array of float64 with NaN at non-numeric slots, plus a parallel state array of strings
vectors.must_not: store outcome labels inside a float64 array

vectors.closes: ORDER-01 — F13 — row order and row count unspecified
vectors.expected_rlo_axis_order: kk = 0..9 ascending, then r_lo = 6.0 at index 10
vectors.acc_rows_composition: 11 MODEL-W r_lo nodes + 1 MODEL-R at 6.0 + 4 branches; the section 14 run is excluded

vectors.closes: BRANCH-01 — B8 — a branch with no numeric L95 had no disposition
vectors.expected_row_content: the state label in place of L95 and SdMC

vectors.closes: structural — multiple crossings
vectors.scenario: the acceptance set is disconnected and the grid ends rejected
vectors.expected_L95_rule: the supremum of the acceptance set, i.e. the crossing at the LAST falling transition

vectors.closes: structural — refinement loses the crossing it was sent to find
vectors.scenario: the refined grid contains no accepted-then-rejected pair
